app.tagline: Portable, install-free network audit and documentation.
arp.active_unsupported: Active ARP requests are only available on Windows; showing the system ARP table only.
cmd.arp: show the ARP table (IP → MAC neighbours)
cmd.discover: discover active devices on the network
cmd.interfaces: list network interfaces and suggested subnets
cmd.scan: full audit: discovery, ports and service identification
cmd.show: show the inventory of a saved audit
col.name: Name
discover.summary: {count} device(s) found in {seconds} s (OUI database: {oui} prefixes).
flag.arp.active: first query each address with ARP (Windows, no admin rights)
flag.arp.range: range to query with --active (default: suggested subnets)
flag.discover.no-dns: do not resolve reverse DNS names
flag.interfaces.all: also show interfaces that are down or have no IPv4
flag.ports.no-discover: scan every address without prior discovery
flag.ports.no-udp: do not probe UDP services (DNS, NetBIOS, SNMP, SSDP, mDNS)
flag.ports.yes: do not ask for confirmation with the full profile
flag.scan.authorized: confirm you are authorised to audit this network (first audit of a site)
flag.scan.no-discover: audit every address without prior discovery
flag.scan.site: save the audit in this site (created if needed)
flag.scan.technician: technician's name (recorded in the history and the report)
flag.scan.yes: do not ask for confirmation with the full profile
hello.legal: Reminder: only audit a network you are authorised to audit.
legal.confirm: I confirm I am authorised to audit the network of site "{site}".
legal.warning: Scanning a network without permission is illegal, in Belgium and elsewhere. Only audit networks you own or for which the owner has given you explicit permission.
netinfo.no_subnet: No subnet to suggest: this machine is not connected to any IPv4 local network.
netinfo.reduced: — larger network, reduced to this machine's /24
ports.full_confirm: The full profile tests all 65535 ports on each device: it is slow and more visible on the network. Continue?
ports.summary: {open} open port(s) on {hosts} device(s) in {seconds} s.
site.no_audit: No completed audit for this site.
